name: GhostDrawerContent
description: Headless edge-anchored drawer surface for GhostDrawer. Shares GhostDialogContent's focus scope, dismissable layer, scroll lock, and inert isolation; sets data-side and a portal-safe data-dir (plus dir="rtl" when right-to-left) so themes can map logical sides to physical viewport edges. Unmounted while closed. After logical close it stays mounted with data-state="closed", inert, and pointer-events: none only while its own CSS exit transition or animation runs (useGhostPresence), then unmounts; focus, dismissal, scroll lock, and background inert release immediately.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the drawer surface.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Dismisses the topmost open layer on `Escape`.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Dismisses the drawer on outside pointerdown (`true` for `'dialog'`, `false` for `'alertdialog'` by default).

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport content through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

props.name: role
props.description: Semantic ARIA role for the drawer surface (`'dialog'` or `'alertdialog'`).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Drawer heading, description, body content, and action controls rendered while open.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the drawer surface element.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Mounted drawer surface element while open or exiting; null once unmounted.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the drawer surface element when mounted.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Drawer surface marked with class ghost-drawer-content, data-part="content", data-side, and data-dir="ltr" | "rtl".

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while mounted and open.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on data-state while the surface plays its exit motion after logical close; the surface is also inert with inline pointer-events: none until it unmounts.

states.name: side
states.description: data-side reports the effective side (content override or root side).

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open drawer when closeOnEscape is true.
keyboard.Tab: Cycles forward within modal drawers; moves freely in non-modal drawers.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Cycles backward within modal drawers; moves freely in non-modal drawers.
